newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in quiet trading as most traders were still away on leave for the New Year holidays, dealers said on Friday.
"The market was really quiet, most people are still away on their holidays," a local dealer said. "It looks like it's a holiday here."
"There aren't any factors to move the market and I guess this will stay like this even for next week." he added.
In short dates, weekend eased three percentage points to 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent from Tuesday's 8-1/2 8-3/8 percent and week-fixed remained at Tuesday's 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent.
Among term rates, two-months, four-months, and five-months eased 1/16 percentage point to a common 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent from Tuesday's common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.
Nine-months was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent and twelve-months rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent from Tuesday's 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent.
